name: How long does it take to paint a standard-sized room?
description: Painting a standard 10x12 foot room usually takes one to two days, including preparation and drying time.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a standard-sized room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to paint a room depends on its size, the current condition of the walls, and the type of paint being used. On average, a standard 10x12 foot room can be painted in one to two days, including prep work and drying time between coats. Larger rooms or those requiring significant repairs may take longer.
